statusDefinitions.supported: A GA product contract backed by automated evidence.
statusDefinitions.candidate: The intended GA contract; GATE-007 cannot promote it until QUAL-001 passes.
statusDefinitions.qualified: An exact environment that has already passed an actual release rehearsal.

support.contract: Server, Web, and Operations OCI images on linux/amd64 and linux/arm64
support.qualification: REL-001 must prove two clean builds with identical manifest digests on both architectures.

support.contract: Docker Engine 28.5.1 with Docker Compose 2.40.3 on Linux arm64
support.qualification: Clean install, restart, upgrade, backup, restore, and application rollback were rehearsed.

support.contract: Podman 6.0.2 with podman-compose 1.5.0 on macOS arm64 Linux VM
support.qualification: The complete RC aggregate rehearsal passed in this environment.
Kubernetes 1.29.14 and 1.37.0 endpoints passed actual install, failure fence, upgrade, rollback, uninstall, and Secret-preservation lifecycles with Helm 4.2.2.

support.contract: PostgreSQL 17 and 18 over verified TLS; no optional extension is required
support.qualification: Pinned PostgreSQL 17.11 and 18.1 both passed custom-CA TLS migration serialization, validation, rollback, and retry tests.

support.contract: HTTPS S3-compatible storage that passes the NURITEO capability preflight; bundled RustFS 1.0.0 is the single-host default
support.qualification: Compatibility is granted by PUT, GET, HEAD, DELETE, LIST, range, checksum, presign, multipart, and cleanup behavior—not by provider name.

support.contract: Current stable desktop Chrome/Chromium with cross-origin isolation, SharedArrayBuffer, Service Worker, and OPFS
support.qualification: Chrome 154 passed current isolation, SharedArrayBuffer, Service Worker, and OPFS capability qualification; production browser runtime gates remain linked.
COOP/COEP, SharedArrayBuffer, Service Worker, OPFS, and the retained Vite preview smoke passed.
Isolation, preview, OPFS reopen, and quota recovery smoke passed; iOS and mobile Safari are excluded.

support.contract: Local administrator-managed accounts, expiring invitations, optional TOTP MFA, and multiple instance-wide OIDC providers
support.qualification: WebAuthn/passkeys and public self-registration are not part of v1.

support.contract: Forward-only in-place upgrade from the published self-hosted v1 Beta/RC lineage; downgrade is not supported
support.qualification: Beta gate migration 46 and RC.1 migration 50 both passed the upgrade, isolated restore, and application-only rollback matrix; signed artifacts repeat it in QUAL-004.

support.contract: Digest-pinned Core Bundle plus optional Quickstart Add-on Bundle imported through an operator-owned OCI registry
support.qualification: The RC Core Bundle plan passed; signed GA artifacts remain REL-002 through REL-005 and QUAL-004 work.

knownLimits.summary: Managed cloud hosting, billing, and a vendor-operated control plane are not provided.
Project secret or environment-variable injection into browser-executed code is not provided.
Mobile browsers, including iOS Safari, are outside the v1 support claim.
Browser workspaces do not provide Docker, arbitrary Linux binaries, direct TCP databases, or general native Node addons.
NURITEO is not a package proxy or artifact repository; operators integrate an existing npm registry or repository manager.
S3-compatible means the tested minimum capability contract, not every AWS S3 API or provider-specific feature.
Database downgrade is unsupported; rollback restores a verified pre-upgrade backup when schema compatibility is lost.
The v1 Compose profile is single-host; multi-node high availability requires the Helm production profile and operator-managed PostgreSQL and S3.
